name: z_1
expr: max(teeth1, max(14, ceil(2 * (6.4 mm / mn_1 + rim_k + 1.25))))

name: ji_cap1
expr: (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 8 mm) + (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 10 mm) + (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 12 mm) + (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 15 mm) + (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 17 mm) + (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 20 mm) + (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 25 mm) + (shafts[max(1, nfit_1)].d > 30 mm)

name: nfit_b
expr: (if(ser == 1, 22 mm, 24 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 26 mm, 30 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 28 mm, 32 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 32 mm, 35 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 35 mm, 40 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 42 mm, 47 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 47 mm, 52 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 55 mm, 62 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12) + (if(ser == 1, 55 mm, 62 mm) / 2 + brg_Dcap1 / 2 + 2 mm <= a12)

name: ki_1
expr: 1 + (d_bore_1 > 8 mm) + (d_bore_1 > 10 mm) + (d_bore_1 > 12 mm) + (d_bore_1 > 17 mm) + (d_bore_1 > 22 mm) + (d_bore_1 > 30 mm) + (d_bore_1 > 38 mm) + (d_bore_1 > 44 mm)

name: ki_2
expr: 1 + (d_bore_2 > 8 mm) + (d_bore_2 > 10 mm) + (d_bore_2 > 12 mm) + (d_bore_2 > 17 mm) + (d_bore_2 > 22 mm) + (d_bore_2 > 30 mm) + (d_bore_2 > 38 mm) + (d_bore_2 > 44 mm)

name: ki_3
expr: 1 + (d_bore_3 > 8 mm) + (d_bore_3 > 10 mm) + (d_bore_3 > 12 mm) + (d_bore_3 > 17 mm) + (d_bore_3 > 22 mm) + (d_bore_3 > 30 mm) + (d_bore_3 > 38 mm) + (d_bore_3 > 44 mm)

name: ki_4
expr: 1 + (d_bore_4 > 8 mm) + (d_bore_4 > 10 mm) + (d_bore_4 > 12 mm) + (d_bore_4 > 17 mm) + (d_bore_4 > 22 mm) + (d_bore_4 > 30 mm) + (d_bore_4 > 38 mm) + (d_bore_4 > 44 mm)

name: ji_s1
expr: (seat_s1 > 8 mm) + (seat_s1 > 10 mm) + (seat_s1 > 12 mm) + (seat_s1 > 15 mm) + (seat_s1 > 17 mm) + (seat_s1 > 20 mm) + (seat_s1 > 25 mm) + (seat_s1 > 30 mm)

name: ji_s2
expr: (seat_s2 > 8 mm) + (seat_s2 > 10 mm) + (seat_s2 > 12 mm) + (seat_s2 > 15 mm) + (seat_s2 > 17 mm) + (seat_s2 > 20 mm) + (seat_s2 > 25 mm) + (seat_s2 > 30 mm)

name: ji_s3
expr: (seat_s3 > 8 mm) + (seat_s3 > 10 mm) + (seat_s3 > 12 mm) + (seat_s3 > 15 mm) + (seat_s3 > 17 mm) + (seat_s3 > 20 mm) + (seat_s3 > 25 mm) + (seat_s3 > 30 mm)

name: w2
expr: if(mod(z_2, 2) == 0, 180 deg / z_2, 0 deg) - theta_in * z_1 / z_2

name: w4
expr: if(mod(z_4, 2) == 0, 180 deg / z_4, 0 deg) + theta_in * z_1 * z_3 / (z_2 * z_4)

name: yi
expr: max(max(max(ra_1, ra_2), max(ra_3, ra_4)) + c_w, max(brg_D_s2, brg_D_s3) / 2)

name: i_total
label: Target ratio
description: The reduction you want, input turns per output turn. Stage 1 takes 1.1 x its square root, stage 2 the rest; the teeth are whole, so the ratio built (i_actual) is close to it

name: teeth1
label: Pinion teeth, stage 1
description: Teeth of the input pinion; the wheel gets the ratio of stage 1 times as many. Raised where needed so the pinion holds a 10 mm shaft with its key (21 teeth at module 1, 17 at 1.5)

name: teeth3
label: Pinion teeth, stage 2
description: Teeth of the second pinion, kept where it clears the input shaft and wheel 2 clears the output shaft (z3_lo to z3_hi)

name: mi_1
label: Module, stage 1
description: Tooth size of the first stage (ISO 54): pitch diameter = module x teeth

name: up_2
label: Module, stage 2
description: The second stage carries more torque: the same module, or one or two sizes up the ISO 54 series (at most 4 mm)

name: width1
label: Face width, stage 1
description: Width of the teeth of stage 1, kept between 5 and 15 modules (at least 8 mm)

name: width3
label: Face width, stage 2
description: Width of the teeth of stage 2, kept between 5 and 15 modules (at least 8 mm)

name: ser
label: Bearing series
description: ISO 15 deep-groove ball bearings, chosen by the shaft: 60xx light or 62xx medium

name: c_w
label: Gear-to-wall clearance
description: Room between the gears' tips and the housing wall

name: theta_in
label: Input shaft angle
description: Turn the input shaft: every gear and shaft follows

title: Two-stage spur gear reducer
description: A two-stage spur gear reducer: set a target ratio and the tooth counts follow, choose the modules (ISO 54), the face widths, the bearing series, the housing's clearance and wall. Involute teeth (ISO 53 basic rack, 20 deg), each gear keyed (DIN 6885 form A) on a stepped shaft, deep-groove ball bearings (ISO 15, 60xx or 62xx) chosen from the shaft, a split cast housing with bolts, a fill and a drain plug. Twenty-two assertions check the fits and clearances at every point. The front half of the housing is hidden in the view; it is exported with the rest.
